_source: BLS Polymers Limited RHP dated 17-Oct-2026 (SEBI filing 105327); restated standalone, Rs lakhs in the RHP converted to Rs crore. Printed page = PDF page - 4. Price band Rs 142-150 from press reports (exchange notice not yet seen on 22-Oct-2026).

basis.name: BLS Polymers Limited
basis.outside: Price band and lot size from press reports (unconfirmed on exchange at writing)

cites.cl: p. 87 (incl. capital commitments and letter of comfort)

1.finding: Bonus of 3,54,30,164 shares (28-May-2025) is reflected: EPS 1.67 / 4.69 / 5.99 FY24-26 are on the post-bonus count of 4,50,31,834 shares.

2.finding: Operating cash flow Rs 2.65 cr / 25.13 cr / 38.06 cr FY24-26 against PAT Rs 7.52 cr / 21.14 cr / 27.01 cr: cumulative CFO/PAT 118.3%. Q1 FY27 CFO -Rs 6.64 cr as receivables rose.

3.finding: Current tax 24.7% of cumulative FY24-26 PBT; deferred tax small.

4.finding: Promoter-group trader Vinsul Makardi Limited: purchases from it Rs 32.35 cr in FY26 (9.3% of revenue) and Rs 8.12 cr in Q1 FY27; sales to it Rs 9.46 cr in FY24 falling to nil; receivable Rs 6.46 cr at Jun-26; Rs 9.00 cr letter of comfort given for it in FY25. Disclosed.

5.finding: Objects Rs 167.06 cr (capex Rs 77.56 cr + working capital Rs 89.50 cr) over 1.70 crore fresh shares = Rs 98.27 a share before GCP and expenses, below the Rs 142 floor of the reported band.

8.finding: Top customer 31.74% and top-10 66.81% of FY26 revenue; top supplier 71.68% of FY26 raw-material procurement. Typical of a compounder buying resin from a few petrochemical producers; no long-term supply contract stated.

9.finding: Contingent liabilities Rs 9.72 cr (10.2% of FY26 net worth), mainly an Rs 8.00 cr bank guarantee to IOCL; the Rs 9.00 cr letter of comfort for a related party was released by FY26.

R1.finding: Nangia & Co. LLP (peer-reviewed); no change of auditor in three years.

R3.finding: Fresh issue about Rs 255 cr at the reported upper band: a monitoring agency is required above Rs 50 cr; appointment to be confirmed in the Prospectus.

R6.finding: Unistone Capital track record compiled from the RHP.

gaps.item: Price band and lot size not yet seen in an exchange or SEBI filing; press reports give Rs 142-150 and 100 shares
Issue expenses and GCP amount blank in the RHP
Names of the top customer (31.74% of revenue) and top supplier (71.68% of procurement) not disclosed
Insurance-claim and miscellaneous income amounts inside other income not itemised
Issuer KPI EBITDA (Rs 46.60 cr FY26) does not reproduce from the P&L net of other income (Rs 41.90 cr)

overhang: Promoter holding above 20% of post-issue capital
Promoters' minimum contribution (20% of post-issue capital)

rationale.g1: Revenue +10.82% (FY25) and +6.39% (FY26), led by trading; manufactured polymer revenue Rs 254.42 cr -> Rs 241.62 cr -> Rs 237.00 cr FY24-26 (pp. 406, 408). Capacity rises from 35,251 to 87,301 MTPA (+148%) with commercial production by FY28, from 73-75% utilisation now (pp. 123-124). Neutral steps up growth in FY28-29 as the new lines fill; Bear assumes slow ramp-up; Bull assumes export orders through the GCC arrangement (p. 124).
rationale.m: Operating EBITDA (PBT + finance cost + D&A - other income, our computation from p. 85) Rs 16.41 cr / 31.77 cr / 41.90 cr FY24-26 = 5.54% / 9.67% / 11.99% of revenue, and 14.46% in Q1 FY27. The issuer's KPI EBITDA (Rs 46.60 cr, 13.33%) does not net off other income in full despite its stated definition (p. 144). Bear = three-year average (9.1%); Neutral = FY26 actual (12.0%); Bull = Q1 FY27 level (14.5%).
rationale.nwc: Trade working capital 35.5% / 30.7% / 27.5% of revenue FY24-26 (p. 84). Neutral 29%, near the FY25-26 level and below the three-year average, since FY26 is the base year; Bear 33%; Bull holds FY26.
rationale.capex: IPO capex input is Rs 65.77 cr: the Rs 77.56 cr expansion less Rs 11.79 cr already deployed by 31-Aug-2026 from accruals and borrowings (p. 122), which is in the FY26-Q1 base and is recouped from the proceeds. Base-year capex Rs 4.73 cr excludes the Rs 1.74 cr expansion CWIP (p. 86), which is part of the IPO-funded project, so growth capex is not counted twice.

peers: Polymer compounds for wires and cables - issuer's peer, p. 141
Masterbatches and compounds - issuer's peer, p. 141

kpi._cite: Operating EBITDA computed from the restated P&L (p. 85): PBT + finance cost + D&A - other income. The issuer's KPI table (p. 144) shows Rs 21.05 / 39.66 / 46.60 cr, which leaves most other income in.

earnings_quality._note: Pre-tax Rs crore by year [FY24, FY25, FY26]; negative reduces profit.

adjustments.item: Liabilities and provisions written back (in other income)
adjustments.reason: Other income includes write-backs of liabilities 'unpaid for long and deemed no longer payable': Rs 2.80 cr, Rs 4.14 cr and Rs 1.00 cr FY24-26. Non-cash and not from operations.

adjustments.item: Interest waived by related party Basant India Limited
adjustments.reason: Interest of Rs 0.30 cr accrued on a related-party loan in FY24 was waived in FY25, a one-off credit.

adjustments.item: Promoter-family pay at the FY24 level
adjustments.reason: Pay to promoter relatives and a promoter (Rs 2.34 cr in FY24) stopped from FY25; FY26 executive pay was Rs 0.37 cr. A choice that lifts FY25-26 profit, not an accounting entry; shown for information.

adjustments.item: Interest and other income on deposits and receivables
adjustments.reason: Recurring but non-operating; excluding it gives the operating P/E.

checked: Capital work in progress (Rs 1.74 cr FY26, Rs 3.46 cr Jun-26) is the Goa expansion funded by the objects, not P&L costs parked on the balance sheet (pp. 84, 121-124)
Bad debts, doubtful-debt provisions and inventory write-downs are charged through profit (p. 86)
Cash conversion: cumulative operating cash flow is 118% of PAT FY24-26 (p. 86)
Profit taxed in cash: current tax 24.7% of cumulative PBT (p. 85)
No change of auditor in three years (p. 94)
